def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Приводим seed_time к datetime
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    # Фильтруем заказы, которые были созданы до seed_time
    orders_filtered = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Объединяем order_items с отфильтрованными заказами
    df = order_items.merge(
        orders_filtered[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    
    # Фильтруем только нужные product_id
    df = df[df["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    
    # Если нет данных, возвращаем DataFrame с нулями
    if df.empty:
        feature_columns = [
            'count_7d', 'sum_price_7d', 'avg_price_7d', 'sum_freight_7d', 'avg_freight_7d',
            'count_30d', 'sum_price_30d', 'avg_price_30d', 'sum_freight_30d', 'avg_freight_30d',
            'count_90d', 'sum_price_90d', 'avg_price_90d', 'sum_freight_90d', 'avg_freight_90d',
            'count_all', 'sum_price_all', 'avg_price_all', 'sum_freight_all', 'avg_freight_all',
            'count_trend_30d', 'sum_price_trend_30d', 'age_days', 'recency_days'
        ]
        result = pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=feature_columns)
        result.index.name = 'product_id'
        return result
    
    # Вычисляем количество дней до seed_time
    df["days_before"] = (seed_time - df["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    
    # Функция для вычисления признаков за окно (в днях)
    def window_features(data, window_days):
        if window_days is None:
            mask = data["days_before"] >= 0
        else:
            mask = (data["days_before"] < window_days) & (data["days_before"] >= 0)
        sub = data[mask]
        if sub.empty:
            idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
            return pd.DataFrame({
                f"count_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"sum_price_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_price_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"sum_freight_{window_days}d": 0,
                f"avg_freight_{window_days}d": 0,
            }, index=idx)
        grouped = sub.groupby("product_id").agg(
            count=("order_id", "nunique"),
            sum_price=("price", "sum"),
            avg_price=("price", "mean"),
            sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        ).reset_index()
        grouped.columns = ["product_id"] + [f"{col}_{window_days}d" for col in grouped.columns[1:]]
        return grouped.set_index("product_id")
    
    # Вычислим признаки для окон 7, 30, 90 и всех (None)
    windows = [7, 30, 90, None]
    frames = []
    for w in windows:
        fw = window_features(df, w)
        frames.append(fw)
    
    # Объединяем все окна
    features = pd.concat(frames, axis=1)
    
    # Вычислим тренд: сравнение 0-30 дней и 30-60 дней
    mask_curr = (df["days_before"] < 30) & (df["days_before"] >= 0)
    mask_prev = (df["days_before"] >= 30) & (df["days_before"] < 60)
    
    count_curr = df[mask_curr].groupby("product_id").size()
    count_prev = df[mask_prev].groupby("product_id").size()
    sum_price_curr = df[mask_curr].groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
    sum_price_prev = df[mask_prev].groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
    
    count_curr = count_curr.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    count_prev = count_prev.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    sum_price_curr = sum_price_curr.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    sum_price_prev = sum_price_prev.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    
    features["count_trend_30d"] = count_curr - count_prev
    features["sum_price_trend_30d"] = sum_price_curr - sum_price_prev
    
    # Возраст и давность
    first_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
    last_sale = df.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
    age_days = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.days
    recency_days = (seed_time - last_sale).dt.days
    age_days = age_days.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    recency_days = recency_days.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    features["age_days"] = age_days
    features["recency_days"] = recency_days
    
    # Переименовываем None на all
    features.columns = [col.replace("None", "all") for col in features.columns]
    
    # Заполним NaN нулями
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Реиндексируем по entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features
